topic: What antenna design considerations minimize signal attenuation in high-noise power line environments for reliable PLC integration?
consensus_response: Signal attenuation in power lines is a major obstacle to PLC reliability.  High-frequency band selection (above 30MHz) minimizes interference from existing equipment, while directional antennas with optimized impedance matching significantly reduce reflection and signal loss. This combination mitigates noise impact and enhances transmission efficiency. However, careful consideration of modulation schemes like QAM can further improve robustness against fluctuating power line currents.
